title: pinus montezumae subsp. gordoniana
intro: Pinus montezumae subsp. gordoniana, commonly known as the Mexican pine or Gordon's pine, is a subspecies of pine tree native to Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus montezumae subsp. gordoniana include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
